name: Client Developer
summary: Surfaces precise authorization precondition errors in client applications.
description: Builds clients that must distinguish invalid principal payloads from ordinary denies. Uses core.authorize invalid_principal reason_code and null policy_hash to show actionable errors instead of a generic failure.

distinguished_from.how: Consumes structured denial codes in UI/SDK layers, not platform service integration.
Handles client error UX for malformed principals, not tenant-isolation policy authoring.
